title: Batch the shared setup
hook: Changing contexts costs two minutes here. Count the changes.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: that each switch has a setup cost, so grouping similar tasks cuts the number of switches and the time they use

misconception: Switching between kinds of task costs nothing, so their order doesn't matter.
objective: Compare setup overhead under an explicit switching cost.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: Changing contexts costs two minutes here. Count the changes. Which order needs fewer setup switches? Correct option: Group equal tags. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.
